assets.prompt: Create an original 2D fantasy dungeon pixel-art game sprite atlas on a truly transparent background. Crisp hand-placed pixels, rich but controlled charcoal basalt, bronze and ember palette, three-quarter overhead RPG view, no text, no UI, no floor, no shadows. A TWO BY TWO layout with generous transparent gutters, every full silhouette completely contained in its own equal quadrant. TOP LEFT: huge broad forge automaton boss, stocky basalt and oxidized iron body, glowing orange furnace core in chest, one enormous hammer arm and one chain-hook arm, chain neatly hanging close to arm, closed feet, complete silhouette, iconic intimidating readable design. TOP RIGHT: smaller slow furnace-core golem, round heavy torso, vented shoulders, glowing orange core and short thick legs. BOTTOM LEFT: living human forge spear guard, charcoal hood and bronze armor, blue-gray scarf, wielding a long spear diagonally upward contained fully in cell, sturdy stance. BOTTOM RIGHT: living armored lava crab with cracked black shell, small orange seams, two large unequal claws, distinguishable from a scorpion, no tail. All face slightly right with visible front side. Original assets for Naki Legend, consistent detailed 16-bit pixel game art, no copies from existing games. Each subject separated by fully transparent margin.
assets.layout_edit: Re-layout this exact four-creature pixel-art atlas for a Unity game. Preserve all four character designs and their colors and crisp pixel-art style. CRITICAL: a strict TWO BY TWO grid of equally sized square cells. Each creature including every weapon tip, chain, claw and foot must be completely inside its assigned cell, with a 12 percent transparent margin on EVERY side of each cell. Shrink the huge boss especially. Top left forge master; top right small furnace golem; bottom left spear guard; bottom right lava crab. No subject may cross or touch a cell boundary. No floor, no shadows, no extra effects, no text. Genuine fully transparent background. Do not enlarge the boss beyond the bounds of its top-left cell.

assets.prompt: Create an original pixel-art 2D overhead fantasy forge dungeon ENVIRONMENT ASSET ATLAS, TWO BY TWO equal quadrants, transparent background except the floor tile. Rich 16-bit RPG pixel craft, precise edges, charcoal basalt, oxidized bronze iron, restrained warm embers, no text, no UI, no people. TOP LEFT quadrant: a perfectly rectangular seamless flat floor tile of dark rectangular forge stone pavers with small bronze riveted seams and faint warm dust, completely filled right to tile edges, no large orange cracks, no walls or props. TOP RIGHT quadrant: a squat freestanding forge anvil workstation on a basalt plinth with an iron mold, sturdy waist height, complete silhouette isolated on transparency. BOTTOM LEFT quadrant: a wooden and iron counterweight handwheel crane winch with a clearly visible circular wheel, short upright mast and hanging chains, complete isolated silhouette. BOTTOM RIGHT quadrant: a short wide modular lowered evacuation bridge made of parallel iron slats and bronze side rails, topdown three-quarter RPG view, with chains at both ends, complete silhouette isolated. Transparent gutters separating all four subjects. Calm legible game assets not concept paintings.
